    MedRTC.WavCapture (med_ex v0.1.0)

    Copy Markdown View Source

    Pure-Elixir 16-bit PCM WAV parser and one-input / two-output clinical capture runner.

    Streams chunks from a real WAV recording (such as a PhysioNet CirCor DigiScope phonocardiogram) to two independent outputs:

    1. An optional live preview callback (which may drop or reconnect with a browser/WebRTC peer mid-capture).
    2. An independent lossless PCM collector that computes the exact decoded sample count, duration, SHA-256 digest, and continuity state (:observed_continuous | :observed_gap | :unknown) for MedCore.Session.

    parse_wav(arg1)

    Parses an uncompressed PCM WAV binary (handling arbitrary RIFF chunks before fmt and data, as emitted by clinical recorders and PhysioNet CirCor).

    replay(wav, opts)

    Replays a parsed WAV through one input into two independent outputs: a live preview sink (:on_preview_chunk) and a lossless capture collector.

    replay(wav, opts)

    @spec replay(parsed_wav(), keyword()) :: capture_summary()

    Replays a parsed WAV through one input into two independent outputs: a live preview sink (:on_preview_chunk) and a lossless capture collector.

    Options:

    • :acquisition_id (required)
    • :started_at_ms (default 0)
    • :chunk_ms (default 20)

    • :on_preview_chunk (fn chunk_idx, pcm_chunk -> :ok | {:error, term()} end, optional)

    • :drop_capture_indices (MapSet or list of chunk indices simulating real capture loss)
    • :continuity_observable? (default true; when false, reports :unknown)
